Executive Leadership Address

Engr. Prof. Dr. Ehsanullah Kakar

HEC Recognized Leadership
Provincial Charter 2012
Official Statement

Welcome from the Office of the Vice Chancellor

"Welcome to the University of Loralai (UoL), a dynamic convergence of excellence and innovation that is shaping the future of education and research."

As the Vice Chancellor, I am honored to lead this vibrant community toward new horizons of knowledge, discovery, and societal impact.

The University of Loralai (UoL) stands as a distinguished public-sector institution dedicated to the pursuit of excellence in delivering impartial and high-quality education that is accessible to all. Established under the charter granted by the Balochistan Provincial Assembly in 2012, the university embodies an unwavering commitment to nurturing academic growth and disseminating knowledge.

Our academic charter empowers us to cultivate leaders, critical thinkers, and innovators who will drive socio-economic development across Northern Balochistan and Pakistan. We are committed to fostering an inclusive, research-oriented environment equipped with modern digital infrastructure, state-of-the-art laboratories, and comprehensive financial support for our students.

— Engr. Prof. Dr. Ehsanullah Kakar, Vice Chancellor, University of Loralai

Strategic Roadmap

Institutional Priorities Under VC Leadership

Academic Excellence

HEC accreditation across all undergraduate BS programs with continuous faculty training and curriculum modernization.

Digital Transformation

Expanding high-speed campus networks, state-of-the-art computer labs, and e-learning portals for all students.

Inclusivity & Financial Aid

Over 80% of students supported through need-based scholarships, merit bursaries, and HEC financial assistance.
